## Design

### 2026-10-08 – I started this session by reviewing the Starbie project structure and getting familiar with the app flow so I could identify the next task efficiently. I checked the existing code, looked through the

**8h**

I started this session by reviewing the Starbie project structure and getting familiar with the app flow so I could identify the next task efficiently. I checked the existing code, looked through the main screens and logic, and verified the project setup to ensure everything was running correctly before making changes.

What worked well was the overall project organization — the codebase was easy to navigate, and the basic structure was clear enough to understand where the next improvements needed to be made. I was also able to get the project running without major blockers, which helped me move quickly.

What did not work as smoothly was the initial discovery phase: a few parts of the implementation were not immediately obvious, so I had to trace through a few files and components to understand the intended behavior before changing anything. There were also a couple of setup/configuration details that took a little extra time to sort out, but they were manageable.

Overall, this session was a productive setup and review phase. I’ve built a clear understanding of the project and am ready to move into the actual implementation work next.
